Synopsis:
    Fed Governor Waller signaled patience on rate hikes, pushing markets back to a ~50/50 coin flip on whether the Fed hikes or holds this month. August NFP (median +56k) prints later in the day but Waller effectively de-emphasized it — August CPI next week is the true deciding variable. The yield curve bull-steepened. Asian equities rallied on the dovish tilt; US and European futures are flat. The yen is surging (~2.5% WTD to 156/USD), with BOJ hike expectations building (~75% priced for this month, 30bps expected by October). Oil is near 6-week highs (Brent ~$95.52). OpenAI released a new flagship LLM called Astra.
